items.summary: Remove the existing HellCodMC logo from the top-left corner by deleting the SiteLogo component references and file

Create a new Header component with a clean, minimal, semi-transparent navigation bar featuring glassmorphism styling with soft blur, low-opacity background, and navigation items with smooth hover glow effects in bright cyan or soft purple with gentle transition animations
Replace the current background with a smooth vertical gradient transitioning from rich medium blue at the top to soft light sky blue at the bottom, ensuring the gradient is clean and non-pixelated

Overlay crisp, pixelated Minecraft-style white clouds with sharp square edges that drift slowly from left to right in a seamless loop, moving in a gentle wave motion with very slight stepped up-and-down pixel movement, keeping the sky smooth while clouds remain distinctly blocky

Redesign the hero section as a centered layout with strong visual hierarchy and balanced spacing, featuring a premium glassmorphism server IP card with semi-transparent dark blue background, soft background blur effect, rounded corners, subtle low-opacity white border, and soft layered shadow for depth separation
Add a subtle animated cyan glow with smooth pulsing effect to the server IP text within the hero card
Include a minimal copy-to-clipboard button with a clean Minecraft-inspired pixel icon and hover feedback animation in the server IP card

Create three floating modern content cards below the hero card displaying 'Game Mode: Lifesteal SMP', 'Version: Any Version Can Play', and 'User Support: Both Java and Bedrock' with hover animations including slight lift effect, soft glow, and subtle scale increase, maintaining consistent spacing and alignment
Update typography throughout the site with primary headings in pure white, secondary body text in soft icy blue, and accent phrases highlighted in bright cyan or soft purple

Add a floating primary action button labeled 'Join Now' that combines a subtle Minecraft pixel aesthetic with modern UI polish, including soft hover glow, smooth transitions, and a gentle bounce animation for visual engagement

Ensure full responsive layout optimization for mobile (320px, 640px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+) breakpoints with strong contrast, accessibility standards, and seamless animations across all device types
Remove the IntroSequence component and its associated state management from App.tsx to eliminate the black screen intro animation
Update the Header component to be rendered at the top of App.tsx, replacing or preceding existing content
Update frontend/src/index.css to remove the Minecraft sky background image and apply the smooth blue vertical gradient instead
Update frontend/tailwind.config.js to include cyan, soft purple, icy blue, and appropriate blue shades that match the new design direction for use throughout components
